commits.step: Restore opt-in public quote/budget/wall-clock/CLI preparation parity.
Integrate realised local team reward; construct neither disabled WM teacher nor WM credit.
Require successful native both-seed all8 augmented-execution admission.
Evaluate each acting CAV context, deterministic single ownership and isolated masks.
Separate smoke artifacts/jobs and share once-only augmentation plus accounting.
Bind full native admission evidence, update regressions and CPU smoke receipts.

1.implementation: MAIN 02:30 launch pins dense teaching and WM group credit OFF with zero verification budgets. Enabled P2 track2_reward receives only projected local before/after SUMO observations. T2C checks exact observable per-vehicle reward membership and computes own + weight * neighbour mean for each actor. Realised returns enter only the frozen-base layer learner; A retains native PPO.

registration.provenance: T2C proposed equal own/neighbour-mean weighting; MAIN 02:30; approval-bound, no tuning

1.coverage: Numerical layer updates change when realised outcomes change; base is frozen; A remains on native PPO; local HDV reward contributes; remote rewards are refused; WM modules can be absent. Monitor, smoke, source inventory, request and operator contract reflect the redesign.

2.implementation: 24 proposals per arm, at most two verified per arm, once before smoke/run. Native sumo_verify.verify and verify_perseed.confirm_all8 execute both seeds, measured later-harm and cooperation checks through coordinator-owned complete-wave reservations. Only admitted cooperative positive own-seed examples are used. New effective samples and AWR weights come from the modified execution tape.
2.binding: Sealed all8 confirmation + matching seed verification receipt + plan digest + TRAIN world seed + snapshot identity/file hash + raw tape digest + effective-sample/weight hashes. Missing/copied/negative/unverified examples cannot enter either imitation or practice.
2.coverage: Partial success, negative native outcomes, missing/copied receipts, changed snapshot/seed including a copied seed claim, changed effective targets/weights, exhausted allowance, complete windows, actual native materialisation and unchanged once-only caches.

3.implementation: Independent active move/onset/RNG state for each acting CAV, stable actor iteration and locally projected sensing/causal reports. Each actuator has one deterministic context owner, followed by the existing native safety writer. Isolated all/solo branches evaluate exactly the selected members with common-base background.
3.coverage: Disconnected far group, each solo mask, empty mask, all CAVs, row permutation, no double-added residual, and the real native V2V controller over the complete episode.

4.implementation: One approved config/root/ledger. Smoke uses smoke/ artifacts, T2C_SMOKE.claim and t2c_smoke_ job IDs; full run uses root artifacts, T2C_RUNTIME.claim and t2c_ IDs. A shared one-use start claim prevents first-start races. Full admission after attempted smoke requires its completed sealed matching config/registration receipt and reloads fresh common u0 models. Immutable augmentation caches are shared and charged only once.
4.coverage: Complete smoke followed by full update 1 for A/B/R, disjoint job IDs, cumulative charges, retained smoke checkpoints/caches, fresh u0 weights, duplicate/interrupted invocation refusal and mismatched approval-binding refusal.

5.implementation: Public quote/budget/wall_clock and CLI preserve committed baseline output absent/false; explicit track2=True or --track2 selects the new producers, with consistent internal Track 2 consumers.
5.coverage: Committed-baseline comparison, default CLI output, default quote/request/preflight flow, explicit Track 2 CLI, existing action/RNG/checkpoint/root/ledger OFF parity.
